description_en: Continuously performs canary release migration for newly added devices
description_zh: 调用该接口持续灰度迁移新增设备
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-gray-migration-device --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-names example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchGrayMigrationDevice

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The list of device names to be migrated through canary release.

You can specify up to 10 device names in a single call. Device names that exceed the limit of 10 are discarded
parameters.help_zh:
待灰度迁移的设备名称列表。

单次调用本接口，最多传入10个设备名称。超出10个的设备名称会被直接丢弃
parameters.name: device_names
